metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Awareness (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Cognitive Envelope for RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative awareness projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Awareness is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, alignments, context, log, dashboard, overlay, history, and analytics.

rtt_node.awareness: System recognizes current RTT node and its constraints.
rtt_node.notes: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.

regime.awareness: System identifies regime and its operational boundaries.
regime.notes: Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

substrate.awareness: System is aware of substrate class and harmonic eligibility.

operator.awareness: System recognizes active operator and its measure requirements.
operator.notes: Operator MUST match current RTT node.

consent.awareness: System is aware of consent state and AA3 gating.

lineage.awareness: System tracks lineage continuity and collapse effects.

collapse.awareness: System is aware of collapse readiness and RTT12 rules.

lattice_stability.awareness: System recognizes lattice stability as strong.

paradox_awareness.notes: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.

projection_rules: Awareness MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.
Awareness MUST NOT invent measure values.
Awareness MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Awareness MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be nominal, harmonic, or resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.

non_claims: Awareness does not revise RTT v0.9.
Awareness does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Awareness does not replace the human FFT book.
